title: Rav Kahana, Brother of Rav Yehudah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Chullin 111b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.111b.7): “He sat before Rav Huna.” But Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be: “Rav Kahana sat behind Rav Yehudah,” and so it is in the Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Chullin has Rav Kahana, brother of Rav Yehudah, sit before Rav Huna.
Hyman proposes a different wording: Rav Kahana sat behind Rav Yehudah. He attributes that reading to the Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim.
